text:
Alex: Hey team — pushed a followup that addresses the serializer edge case and the feedback from yesterday. Split the migration into a separate commit and added a tiny smoke test. PTAL when you have a minute, linking the PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/482
Sam: Nice, thanks for doing the split. quick question — did you keep the old header names stable? downstream infra reads X-RW-Model so we need backward compat.
Alex: Yep, kept the header names. I added a deprecation log and a compatibility shim. Example call I used for local smoke:```bash
curl -H 'X-RW-Model: mia-small' \ 
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' \ 
  https://localhost:8080/v1/generate
```
Ria: Ran the smoke locally — behavior looks identical to before. One tiny nit: the new smoke test has a 10s timeout which flakes on my laptop occasionally. Can you bump to 30s? PTAL.
Alex: Good catch, bumped to 30s and re-ran. Squashed the migration commits and left one descriptive commit message. Also added a short changelog note under "runtime: serializer compatibility".
Sam: LGTM from my side after timeout bump. Left a comment suggesting a tiny assertion for header presence but it's optional.
Jon: I can merge once CI is green and no other objections. Prefer to merge before tomorrow's canary so ops can validate. Any blockers?
Alex: No blockers from me. I flagged the canary window in the PR description.
CI-bot: build/482 — linux-x64: PASSED, tests: 312/312, coverage: 87.1% :white_check_mark:
Deploy-bot: Canary slot reserved for 2025-06-12 08:00 UTC in us-west-2.
Ria: Thanks — I'll watch the canary and run the targeted inference regression at T+15m. If everything is good I'll give a :thumbsup:.
Jon: OK I'll merge after the green CI and add a short deploy note. Alex — do you want to keep the branch or delete after merge?
Alex: Delete branch after merge is fine. Thanks everyone :pray: 
Sam: :shipit:
Jon: Merging after one more CI run, will ping in #eng once merged.
